Wait for kotlin-lsp installation to finish

Operations run in the selected worktree. They may download packages and execute project scripts. Save edits first; the AI workspace stays paused until completion. Reports are available in project files.
For Python, select the project venv interpreter, such as .venv/bin/python. For Gradle/Conan, Python runs the tool.

Gradle: graph of all resolvable configurations, selected versions and selection reasons. Pinning writes lock files and enables locking for regular builds of the root project. Plugins and included builds need separate pinning.

pip: dependencies and versions in the selected environment, with pip check conflict detection. Pinning saves the entire venv to requirements.dp-ide.lock; restoration requires a venv. Local, VCS and editable packages need manual pinning.
Conan 2: C++ package graph from an existing conanfile and a native conan.lock. CMake without a package manager has no universal version locking; dependencies are defined by the project.
Request accepted; the result will appear below.
Cannot start: check the workspace, Python command and other running operations.

Project gradle.lockfile files, ./gradle/dp-ide-locking.gradle and the root build.gradle(.kts) will change. Review the Git diff afterwards and commit them together. If Gradle fails, some lock files may have changed; the app will report the failure.

requirements.dp-ide.lock will be replaced by a snapshot of the checked venv. It pins versions for the current Python platform without archive hashes; original requirements and pyproject files stay as they are.
Conan will create or replace conan.lock using conanfile and the active target profile. Review the changes before committing.
pip will install requirements.dp-ide.lock versions in the selected venv. Packages may be downloaded and built.
For Android projects: use the app SDK

Tools for the main project tree. Use an existing check or diagnostic first; AI receives the same catalog. Tool readiness is checked before execution.

After you send a message, the model can read and change this project and run its check/build profiles. Code is sent to the selected provider; the API key and other projects are not exposed. Setup does not start a paid task.
Preparing the project and environment. Existing clones and settings are preserved.
API models can work on a project through quick start. Ordinary chats and advanced profile setup are also available.
The API model deleted this file. You can undo the last change in the project workspace.
The API model changed a file that could not be reloaded. Restart the language service.
The API turn was interrupted by an app restart. Files may have changed: review changes and the last backup in the workspace. Commands are not automatically repeated.
